semiconductor_relevance: High — Anupam Rasayan India Limited specializes in the custom synthesis and manufacturing of specialty chemicals, including materials specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited is a leading manufacturer of specialty chemicals, focusing on high-performance materials for the semiconductor industry. They provide sophisticated materials with low metal content for both frontend and backend semiconductor processes, including battery chemicals and display chemicals.
capabilities: Manufacturing of fluorinated and non-fluorinated low metal and high purity materials
Custom synthesis of specialty monomers and oligomers for semiconductor applications
Development of niche molecules for electronic ecosystem applications

regional_presence.India: Anupam Rasayan operates eight manufacturing sites and two large-scale R&D centers in India.
